common-m2.joining_case: Common-M2 variant: 3 M2x6 + 2 M2x4 machine screws per half, pitch 0.4 mm; head diameter <=4 mm and height <=2 mm (DIN 912 / ISO 4762 socket caps fit, 1.5 mm hex key). The screws cut their own thread in the printed 2.1 mm pilots on the tested printer; check it on the M2 sample first. No countersunk or self-tapping screws
